Questions people ask

Should we hire you or a full-time marketing leader?+

If you need senior judgment before you can justify a full-time hire, or a specific problem solved fast, an embedded or project engagement is usually the better first step. If the fit is right, I’m also open to full-time roles.

How is working with you different from an agency?+

You work with me directly, not an account manager. When a project needs more hands, I bring in a vetted freelance team and stay accountable for the work.

What’s the smallest engagement?+

A fixed-scope project, such as a positioning sprint or a single launch. We agree the scope after a diagnostic call.

Which regions and time zones do you work with?+

I’m based in Lagos (UTC+1) and work with teams in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa. My hours overlap fully with Europe and the Middle East, and with US mornings.

How is pricing scoped?+

Every engagement is scoped to the problem. After the diagnostic call, you get a written proposal with scope, timeline and either a fixed fee or a monthly rate.
